title: Its been a while - love it
body: The dev is always upgrading the app, adding only useful things, listens to feedback. Besides that I love HabitKit. Been there from the beginning. It just feels good
author: boooiiiiix

title: I like this app
body: I appreciate that the app continues to receive updates, which is very promising since I already like all its features. It’s a simple yet effective app. I also love the option to export and import files, as it provides a sense of full control—something many apps lack nowadays. Additionally, the support is very helpful and friendly. If you encounter any issues, just reach out, and the developer will respond and assist you quickly, which is really cool. :)
author: UnnamedCharacter
